**Cause:** In `src/tomli/_parser.py`, `parse_hex_char` returned the position of the last hex digit instead of the position just past the escape. `parse_basic_str` resumes scanning from the returned position, so the last digit (`9` in `\u00e9`) was read again as literal text. Other escapes like `\n` already return the position p
